$comment: Time-bounded exceptions to the dependency audit (scripts/ci/dependency-audit.mjs). Each one covers one advisory in one package, reached only through `via` for pnpm, until `expires` (at most 120 days ahead). Renew only after re-checking for a fix.

exceptions.reason: The fix is only in zod 4.6.6, and no patched 3.x release exists. puppeteer-core 25.12.0 pins chromium-bidi 17.0.2, which requires zod ^3, so a zod 4 override would force a major version on it. It is a memory-exhaustion denial of service on oversized constrained collections; here chromium-bidi only validates protocol messages from a locally launched browser during lighthouse runs, never untrusted input, and nothing ships to WordPress sites. Drop this once @wordpress/scripts reaches a puppeteer-core whose chromium-bidi uses zod 4.
